name: Antichain Number of Repeated-Coordinate Cubes
proof: For target $h_v$, put $w=(v_2,\ldots,v_n)$ and assign the sample $\{(z_w,v_1)\}$. It is consistent since every $z_w$ reads the first bit. Distinct bit strings $v$ give distinct labeled singleton samples: either their suffixes choose different coordinate copies, or their first bits give different labels at the same copy. Hence the samples form an antichain of width one. There are $2^n\ge2$ concepts, so width zero is impossible. This proves AN exactly one, including $n=1$.
references: Local definition-driven proof; bounded independent replay in sync/verify_noclashing_antichain_gap.py.
